verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an AI assistant built into Fellow itself is a bare "Ask Fellow" line on the pricing page. That suggests an in-product assistant, but nothing describes what it does or shows it can take on tasks. The MCP server evidence covers external chatbots (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) querying Fellow data, so it is not a built-in assistant and is not credited. Automatic AI summaries and action items are generated outputs, not user-delegated tasks. Missing for 10: any documentation of Ask Fellow's capabilities, evidence that users can delegate tasks (not just ask questions) to it, examples of it acting inside the product, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
